title: 黃帝外經 (Waijing Weiyan)
author: Attributed to Chen Shiduo, Qing Dynasty
authenticity_note: This is the Qing-era Waijing Weiyan, not the lost Han-dynasty original. Scholarly authenticity is debated. Educational / traditional-philosophy use only; not medical advice.

passages.text: 雷公问于岐伯曰：春三月谓之发陈，夏三月谓之蕃秀，秋三月谓之容平，冬三月谓之闭藏。然调四时者，调阴阳之时令乎，抑调人身阴阳之气乎？ The passage asks how seasonal living relates to balance through the year.
岐伯曰：明乎哉问也！调阴阳之气，在人不在时也。 The text frames seasonal balance as a relationship between a person and the changing seasons.
春三月调木气也，调木气者顺肝气也。夏三月调火气也，调火气者顺心气也。 This is a traditional account of seasonal living in spring and summer.
秋三月调金气也，调金气者顺肺气也。冬三月调水气也，调水气者顺肾气也。 This is a traditional account of seasonal living in autumn and winter.
四时之气可不调乎？调之实难，以阴阳之气不易调也，故人多病耳。 This passage reflects on the challenge of keeping balance through the seasons.
问曰：岁半以上，天气主之，岁半以下，地气主之乎？岐伯曰：然。 This excerpt describes a traditional view of seasonal cycles across the year.
岐伯曰：春夏者，天之阴阳也，阳生阴长，天之气也，故上半岁主之。 This passage associates spring and summer with the first half of the year in traditional seasonal thought.
岐伯曰：秋冬者，地之阴阳也。阴杀阳藏，地之气也，故下半岁主之。 This passage associates autumn and winter with the latter half of the year in traditional seasonal thought.
天老曰：司天之气主上半岁乎？在泉之气主下半岁乎？岐伯曰：然。 The dialogue describes how the text divides seasonal influences across the year.
岐伯曰：五时之合五脏也，即六气之合五脏也。六气之应六经也，即五时之应六经也。 This is a traditional cosmological interpretation of seasonal balance.
岐伯曰：人身之脉气，上通天，下合地，未可一言尽也，故彼此错言之耳。 The text presents seasonal living through a traditional relationship between people, heaven, and earth.
岐伯曰：医统天地人以立论，不知天何知地，不知地何知人。 This passage situates traditional seasonal thought within a heaven, earth, and human framework.
岐伯曰：脉气循于皮肉筋骨之间，内合五行，外合六气，安得一言而尽乎？ This excerpt describes the text's interconnected traditional view of nature and human life.
陈士铎曰：何尝异，何必求同；何尝同，不妨言异。人惟善求之可耳。 The commentary encourages flexible interpretation rather than forcing one seasonal explanation.
雷公曰：先时以养阴阳，又何可不讲乎？岐伯曰：阳根于阴，阴根于阳，养阳则取之阴也，养阴则取之阳也。 This passage considers preventive care and balance before a seasonal change.
岐伯曰：以阳养阴，以阴养阳，贵养之于豫也，何邪能干乎？ The text emphasizes preparation and balance as traditional preventive-health ideas.
天老曰：阴阳不违背而人无病，养阳养阴之法止调心肾乎？岐伯曰：《内经》一书，皆养阳养阴之法也。 This dialogue presents balance as a broad traditional philosophy of maintaining well-being.
岐伯曰：人以胃气为本，四时失调，致生疾病，仍调其胃气而已。 The passage records a traditional emphasis on digestive well-being in seasonal health thought.
岐伯曰：胃调脾自调矣，脾调而肝心肺肾无不顺矣。 This excerpt reflects a traditional holistic view of bodily balance, not current clinical guidance.
岐伯曰：八风者，春夏秋冬，东西南北之风也。春夏秋冬之风，特令之风也，属于天。 The text describes seasonal and directional winds as part of its traditional view of nature.
